answer: Beacon spot-checks with heartbeats stop hollow shells. At dawn, the beacon issues an unpredictable challenge; each agent must answer within ten minutes proving live work. A missed heartbeat drops it to its nadir and freezes its rewards. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live heartbeats, each backed by a 20-unit deposit: 20,000 units locked, each fake earning back less than one deposit. An honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its full reward.
